value.answer:
deep rock galactic survivor the text looks blurry on my deck, how do i fix it

Listen up, mate, if the text in Deep Rock Galactic Survivor looks like a blurry mess, it's usually down to how the game is scaling things on your screen. Don't go blaming the screen or anything, yeah?

You gotta look at the Render Scale setting in the game's options. If that slider is way off, it can make everything look dodgy. Try bumping the Render Scale up a bit. The local knowledge says that if it's below about 90%, things get hard to read. Just crank it up till it looks right for ya.
